title: Store Update 1.48.0
body:
# Store Update 1.48.0

Raiders!

Update 1.48.0 is rolling out now, adding two new colour variants for the Misthorn Set: Blue Silver and Green Wood. If you already own the set, these variants will be applied to you automatically. There's no need to restart your game.

Next Tuesday's update is being skipped to clear the way for Frozen Trail, which launches on Thursday, October 8th!

See you Topside, //Ossen
